description: Optional reference for the format of a plan saved with mappu_save_trip_plan: how Mappu's own planner handles a day, timing and opening days, season, the places' background, food and practical tips, and which field each part goes in. It applies only to plans saved to Mappu. Takes no input and returns Markdown.
name: mappu_get_trip_planning_guide
title: Get Mappu's trip planning guide
